responsibility: Implements the mutable analysis state that records reachability information for privacy checking. This file owns PrivacyContext’s DefId-to-ReachLevel map updates and lookups, including the monotonic "raise only" merge behavior used while visiting HIR items, and it also contains selftests for that reachability bookkeeping rather than any traversal logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the privacy-context pair: unlike rust-privacy-ctx.h, it defines the reachability-map update/lookup behavior, including the raise-only merge policy and selftests, rather than just introducing the state container and enum.
